annotations.title: Check bank account with the tax authority

description: Checks live whether a bank account is reported to the tax authority for a given taxpayer: Poland (Ministry of Finance white list, 'Wykaz podatników VAT'; the answer carries the ministry's identifier of the query, request_id) or Czechia (register of VAT payers, published accounts, with the flag 'nespolehlivý plátce' / unreliable VAT payer). It shows whether the account is reported for this taxpayer; it does not prove who owns the account, and 'not registered' is a hint, not a judgement. Poland: the NIP and the account are sent to the ministry. Czechia: only the DIČ is sent to the register; the account is compared locally with the published list.

account.description: The bank account: IBAN, or the national form (PL: 26-digit NRB; CZ: prefix-number/bank code, e.g. 19-2000145399/0800).

tax_id.description: PL: NIP (10 digits, with or without PL and dashes). CZ: DIČ (CZ followed by 8 to 10 digits).
